'''Eopie stew''' was a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] made with [[Eopie/Legends|eopie]] meat. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], eopie stew was served on [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora's]] [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], located on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].
